barriers.reason: Infusion is Tuesdays at 8:30 AM and the patient relies on a husband who switches to the night shift on infusion days, so an early morning ride may not be available or reliable each cycle.

alternatives.text: Ask the infusion unit for a later Tuesday chair time or a cycle day that fits the husband's shifted schedule.
If a health condition prevents using fixed-route buses/trains, apply for ADA Paratransit certification (312-663-HELP); note it is not immediate and runs only when fixed-route service runs.

Check coverage: if Medicaid/dual, arrange managed-care NEMT through the plan card or Transdev for fee-for-service; if Medicare-only, only confirm a ride if a Medicare Advantage transportation benefit exists—do not promise original Medicare coverage.

barriers.reason: Pre-cycle labs and oncology review require travel every two weeks on the same husband-dependent ride schedule that may fail for early morning appointments.

alternatives.text: Schedule lab draws on the same day/campus as the Tuesday infusion, or use telehealth for review when no exam is needed.
Request lab/appointment times that align with when the husband is available to drive.
If eligible, pursue ADA Paratransit certification for recurring medical trips, understanding certification must be completed first.
